非谓语动词(二):不定式 to do: 表"目的"与"将要发生的动作",want、decide、hope 后面都跟着它。

作宾语:want / decide / hope / plan / agree + to do|作目的状语:I got up early to catch the train|形容词后接 to do:happy / sorry / easy + to do|作主语:To err is human|动词 + 宾语 + to do:ask / tell / allow sb to do|stop to do 停下来去做另一件事
We decided to change the plan.
He came here to ask for help.
She is easy to get along with.
My parents allowed me to choose my own subjects.
column3: 父母允许我自己选科目。
